document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const container = document.querySelector(".blog-filter__inner");
  if (!container) return;

  const tagFilter = document.createElement("div");
  tagFilter.className = "inner-frame blog-filter__tag";
  tagFilter.innerHTML = `
    <label for="post_tag">Filter By Tag</label>
    <select name="tag" id="post_tag">
      <option value="">All</option>
    </select>
  `;
  container.appendChild(tagFilter);

  const select = tagFilter.querySelector("select");

  // Fetch tags dynamically from WordPress REST API
  fetch("/wp-json/wp/v2/tags?per_page=100")
    .then((res) => res.json())
    .then(async (tags) => {
      for (const tag of tags) {
        // Check if there is at least 1 post under this tag
        const postsRes = await fetch(`/wp-json/wp/v2/posts?tags=${tag.id}&per_page=1`);
        const posts = await postsRes.json();
        if (posts.length > 0) {
          const opt = document.createElement("option");
          opt.value = tag.slug;
          opt.textContent = tag.name;
          select.appendChild(opt);
        }
      }

      // Preselect the active tag if URL has one
      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const activeTag = urlParams.get("tag");
      if (activeTag) {
        select.value = activeTag;
      }
    })
    .catch((err) => console.error("Error loading tags:", err));

  // Change filter
  select.addEventListener("change", function () {
    const selected = this.value;
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    params.set("tag", selected);
    window.location.search = params.toString();
  });
});



</script> </div> </div> </div> </div> </header> <div class="m-banner m-banner--small  gt-s gb banner-hero order-default"> <div class="m-banner__container container" style="--columns-ratio: 100%;"> <div class="m-banner__content"> <div class="l-banner__text"> <div class="l-banner__inner text-left"> <div class="c-heading -h1"> <h1 class="c-heading__title"><span>Feel Better. class="elementor-widget-container">  <script>
const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.card-solutions');

cards.forEach(card => {
  const desc = card.querySelector('.description-solution');

  card.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
    desc.style.transition = 'height 0.4s ease, opacity 0.4s ease';
    desc.style.opacity = '1';

    desc.style.height = 'auto';
    const height = desc.clientHeight + 'px';
    desc.style.height = '0px';

    // Форсим reflow
    desc.offsetHeight;

    desc.style.height = height;
  });

  card.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
    desc.style.transition = 'height 0.4s ease, opacity 0.4s ease';
    desc.style.opacity = '0';
    desc.style.height = '0px';
  });
});

</script> <script>
jQuery(window).on('elementor/frontend/init', function() {
  console.log('elementor/frontend/init fired');
  
  elementorFrontend.hooks.addAction('frontend/element_ready/global', function($scope) {
    console.log('element_ready/global fired');
    
    var $carousel = $scope.find('.swiper');
    console.log('Found swipers:', $carousel.length);
    
    if (!$carousel.length) return;
    
    $carousel.each(function() {
      var $el = jQuery(this);
      
      if ($el.find('.custom-fraction').length) {
        console.log('Fraction уже есть');
        return;
      }
      
      var attempts = 0;
      var maxAttempts = 100;
      var poll = setInterval(function() {
        attempts++;
        var instance = $el[0] && $el[0].swiper;
        
        if (instance) {
          clearInterval(poll);
          console.log('Swiper instance найден', instance);
          
          var total = instance.slides.length - (instance.loopedSlides || 0) * 2 || instance.slides.length;
          var $fraction = jQuery('<div class="swiper-pagination-fraction custom-fraction"></div>');
          
          var $progress = $el.find('.swiper-pagination-progressbar').first();
          if ($progress.length) $progress.before($fraction); else $el.append($fraction);
          
          function update() {
            var current = (typeof instance.realIndex !== 'undefined') ? instance.realIndex + 1 : (instance.activeIndex + 1);
// Форматируем с ведущим нолём:
function formatNum(num) {
  return num < 10 ? '0' + num : num;
}

var maxSlides = 6; // фиксированное общее количество слайдов
$fraction.text(formatNum(current) + ' / 0' + maxSlides);
            console.log('Fraction updated:', current + ' / ' + total);
          }
          
          update();
          instance.on('slideChange transitionEnd observerUpdate slidesLengthChange', update);
        }
        
        if (attempts >= maxAttempts) {
          clearInterval(poll);
          console.warn('custom-fraction: swiper instance не найден для', $el);
        }
      }, 100);
    });
  });
});

class="c-accordion__item js-acc-item is-active"> <h4 class="c-accordion__title-wrap -h4"> <button class="js-acc-button c-accordion__title">
						What makes MD Total Wellness the top choice for wellness care in Orange County?        </button> </h4> <div class="js-acc-content"> <div class="c-accordion__content"> <div class="is-wysiwyg"> <p>As a physician-owned clinic in Brea, CA, MD Total Wellness stands out by bridging gaps in traditional medicine with evidence-based, root-cause treatments grounded in science. We offer clinically proven therapies to optimize wellness and improve quality of life. Unlike standard healthcare, our board-certified providers deliver concierge-level care tailored to your specific needs — helping Orange County residents achieve lasting mental, physical, and emotional wellness. Schedule a free consult to experience the difference.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="c-accordion__item js-acc-item"> <h4 class="c-accordion__title-wrap -h4"> <button class="js-acc-button c-accordion__title">
						Who are the providers at MD Total Wellness?        </button> </h4> <div class="js-acc-content"> <div class="c-accordion__content"> <div class="is-wysiwyg"> <p>Dr. David Oliak, MD, and PA Allison Mollet, PA-C, have worked together since 2006 — first in Dr. Oliak’s bariatric surgery practice, now in functional wellness at MDTW. Dr. Oliak is board-certified and brings deep clinical expertise in weight loss that few GLP-1 providers can match. PA Mollet is menopause-certified and specializes in helping women navigate hormonal changes. Together, they’ve helped thousands of Orange County patients achieve lasting results. Book a free consult to meet them.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="c-accordion__item js-acc-item"> <h4 class="c-accordion__title-wrap -h4"> <button class="js-acc-button c-accordion__title">
						What is the philosophy behind MD Total Wellness’s approach to functional wellness in Brea and Orange County?        </button> </h4> <div class="js-acc-content"> <div class="c-accordion__content"> <div class="is-wysiwyg"> <p>Traditional medicine is designed to treat disease — we believe healthcare should go further. At MDTW, our philosophy is to optimize wellness proactively: addressing root causes, balancing hormones, supporting healthy weight, and restoring vitality before problems become diagnoses. We use evidence-based functional medicine treatments in an in-person, concierge-style setting where your provider actually knows you. Reach out for a free consult to experience the difference .</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="c-accordion__item js-acc-item"> <h4 class="c-accordion__title-wrap -h4"> <button class="js-acc-button c-accordion__title">
						Who benefits most from wellness services at MD Total Wellness in Brea, CA?        </button> </h4> <div class="js-acc-content"> <div class="c-accordion__content"> <div class="is-wysiwyg"> <p>MDTW is ideal for men and women in Orange County who are experiencing unexplained fatigue, weight gain, hormonal changes, low libido, or the effects of aging — and want real answers at a weight loss and hormone clinic they can trust.. Our evidence-based, root-cause approach serves patients from Yorba Linda, Anaheim Hills, Fullerton, Placentia, and beyond. Schedule a free in-office consult to explore what’s right for you.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="c-accordion__item js-acc-item"> <h4 class="c-accordion__title-wrap -h4"> <button class="js-acc-button c-accordion__title">
						How does MD Total Wellness ensure convenient and accessible care for Orange County residents?        </button> </h4> <div class="js-acc-content"> <div class="c-accordion__content"> <div class="is-wysiwyg"> <p>We respect your time. Our Brea clinic offers flexible scheduling, direct provider access, an on-site lab for fast results, and same-day medication dispensing — so you can often start treatment the day you walk in. Telehealth follow-ups are available for established patients. We serve Orange County including Fullerton, Placentia, Yorba Linda, and Anaheim Hills. Contact us for a free consult to get started.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="c-accordion__item js-acc-item"> <h4 class="c-accordion__title-wrap -h4"> <button class="js-acc-button c-accordion__title">
						What is peptide therapy and how do I get started at MD Total Wellness?        </button> </h4> <div class="js-acc-content"> <div class="c-accordion__content"> <div class="is-wysiwyg"> <p>Peptides are short chains of amino acids that signal the body to perform specific functions — from accelerating healing and recovery, to improving body composition, energy, skin health, and mental clarity. At MDTW, we use pharmaceutical-grade (&gt;99% pure), USA-made peptides under medical supervision.</p> <p>We offer two ways to get started: a comprehensive paid consultation for a fully personalized peptide protocol, or a medical clearance pathway that allows you to begin quickly after completing an online questionnaire. Some peptides require an initial consult. Schedule a free consult or contact us to learn which pathway is right for you.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="c-accordion__item js-acc-item"> <h4 class="c-accordion__title-wrap -h4"> <button class="js-acc-button c-accordion__title">
						Is the Alma TED system better than PRP for hair restoration?        </button> </h4> <div class="js-acc-content"> <div class="c-accordion__content"> <div class="is-wysiwyg"> <p>Both Alma TED and PRP are effective hair restoration treatments, but they work differently. Alma TED uses ultrasound and air pressure to deliver a specialized hair care formula deep into the scalp — completely non-invasive and pain-free, with no needles and no downtime. PRP uses your own platelet-rich plasma injected into the scalp to stimulate follicles.</p> <p>At MDTW, we offer a full range of hair restoration options including Alma TED, peptide therapy, red-light therapy, medications, and nutraceuticals, and we build a personalized plan based on your specific type of hair loss. See our full guide to Alma TED vs. PRP, or schedule a consult to find the right approach for you.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="c-accordion__item js-acc-item"> <h4 class="c-accordion__title-wrap -h4"> <button class="js-acc-button c-accordion__title">
						Do you accept insurance at your Orange County wellness clinic?        </button> </h4> <div class="js-acc-content"> <div class="c-accordion__content"> <div class="is-wysiwyg"> <p>No — and here’s why that works in your favor. By not billing insurance, we eliminate prior authorizations, surprise bills, and the time pressure that rushes most medical appointments. You get unhurried, focused care with a provider who actually knows you. We accept all major credit/debit cards, HSA and FSA, and offer 0% financing for treatment packages.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="c-accordion__item js-acc-item"> <h4 class="c-accordion__title-wrap -h4"> <button class="js-acc-button c-accordion__title">
						How can I begin my wellness journey with MD Total Wellness in Orange County?        </button> </h4> <div class="js-acc-content"> <div class="c-accordion__content"> <div class="is-wysiwyg"> <p>It’s simple: Schedule a free in-office consult at our Brea, CA clinic online or by phone. Meet Dr. Oliak or PA Mollet to review your health, discuss your goals, and receive a customized, evidence-based treatment plan — often starting the same day. We provide ongoing follow-up and support to keep you on track. We’re here to help — contact us today to take the first step.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="m-wrapper  gt gb has-overflow container-fluid"> <div 				const registerAllyAction = () => {
					if ( ! window?.ElementorProFrontendConfig || ! window?.elementorFrontend?.utils?.urlActions ) {
						return;
					}

					elementorFrontend.utils.urlActions.addAction( 'allyWidget:open', () => {
						if (window?.ea11yWidget?.widget?.open) {
							return window.ea11yWidget.widget.isOpen()
								? window.ea11yWidget.widget.close()
								: window.ea11yWidget.widget.open();
						}
					} );
				};

				const waitingLimit = 30;
				let retryCounter = 0;

				const waitForElementorPro = () => {
					return new Promise( ( resolve ) => {
						const intervalId = setInterval( () => {
							if ( retryCounter === waitingLimit ) {
								resolve( null );
							}

							retryCounter++;

							if ( window.elementorFrontend && window?.elementorFrontend?.utils?.urlActions ) {
								clearInterval( intervalId );
								resolve( window.elementorFrontend );
							}
								}, 100 ); // Check every 100 milliseconds for availability of elementorFrontend
					});
				};

				waitForElementorPro().then( () => { registerAllyAction(); });

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  document.querySelectorAll('.team-member-block').forEach(function (block) {
    block.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      // Prevent triggering twice if the actual link is clicked
      if (e.target.closest('a.floatbox')) return;

      // Find the floatbox link inside this block
      const popupLink = this.querySelector('a.floatbox');
      if (popupLink) {
        popupLink.click();
      }
    });
  });
});
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  const breakpoint = 992;

  function isMobile() {
    return window.innerWidth < breakpoint;
  }

  if (!isMobile()) return;

  document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item-has-children').forEach(function (menuItem) {
    const link = menuItem.querySelector('a');
    const toggle = menuItem.querySelector('.js-sub-menu-toggle');
    const submenu = menuItem.querySelector('.sub-menu');

    if (!link || !submenu || !toggle) return;

    link.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault(); // prevent navigation if needed

      const isOpen = menuItem.classList.contains('is-opened');

      // Toggle all required classes
      menuItem.classList.toggle('is-opened', !isOpen);
      toggle.classList.toggle('is-toggled', !isOpen);
      submenu.classList.toggle('is-visible', !isOpen);
      submenu.setAttribute('aria-expanded', !isOpen ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
  });
});

data-widget_type="text-editor.default"> <div class="elementor-widget-container"> <p><span style="color: #ffffff;"><b>I absolutely love Dr Oliak and his team! </b></span>They truly listen and understand my needs and help me achieve my goals! The staff is very friendly and helpful. Always greeting me with a smile and are there to assist me with appointments and my check in and any other thing I need. Dr Oliak has a lot of experience in weight loss. He is always so excited to share what is up and coming in the industry, and takes the time to explain my options that best suit my needs. Even though he has been doing this for a long time, he continues to keep up to date on what science and technology are doing, to help people live a more healthy life. If you are looking to lose weight with a supportive team, I highly suggest the MD Wellness Total center! You will not regret it! Bonus, they have all kinds of innovative and amazing technology to treat other things such as incontinence, and other health concerns you may have! I cannot stress enough, let today be the day you make the decision to better your life and be more healthy and happy, And if you want a team to help you be successful, I highly encourage you to do it with Dr Oliak and his team!
